steps.js: (async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.addLocalRepository(__REPO_PATH__); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const before = window.__gitgood.store.get().status; return JSON.stringify({ hasConflictsBefore: before.hasConflicts, conflictedBefore: before.files.filter((f) => f.conflict).map((f) => f.path) }); })()

(async () => { window.__gitgood.actions.selectWorkingFile('other.txt'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); await window.__gitgood.actions.useSide('other.txt', 'ours'); await window.__gitgood.actions.markResolved(['other.txt']); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const examples = await window.__gitgood.invoke('ai.resolve.examples', __REPO_PATH__); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); return JSON.stringify({ examples, conflictExamplesInStore: s.conflictExamples, otherStaged: s.status.files.find((f) => f.path === 'other.txt') ? s.status.files.find((f) => f.path === 'other.txt').conflict : null }); })()

(async () => { await window.__gitgood.actions.resolveAllGuided(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const s = window.__gitgood.store.get(); const file = s.status.files.find((f) => f.path === 'shared.txt'); const resolution = s.conflictResolutions['shared.txt']; return JSON.stringify({ hasConflictsAfter: s.status.hasConflicts, sharedFile: file || null, resolution, toastTitle: s.toasts[0] && s.toasts[0].title }); })()
